entities.summary: Adriana Cisneros Phelps de Griffin is a Venezuelan businesswoman and the CEO of Grupo Cisneros, a privately owned media, entertainment, digital media, real estate, tourism resorts and consumer products company. She is also president of the Fundación Cisneros.
